verdict.rationale: Washington ESD is a state government agency that administers unemployment taxes, quarterly wage reporting and benefits, so a user-selectable storage region does not fit this kind of product. Records held by a state agency are not something a filer could plausibly pick a residency for, and nothing in the evidence shows the agency offers such a choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
